task.description: Implement LUA-12, LUA-15, LUA-16 per the validated Type E design at src/design/iss0625-gh592-lua-12-15-16.md. Three commits in sequence: (1) LUA-15 registry-channel failure anti-forgery + ScriptResult.error_kind discriminator (host_context.zig new helpers, host_api/fail.zig uses registry, executor.zig ScriptResult.error_kind); (2) LUA-12 ExecutionContext.service_catalog + single-table return shape + real HTTP path with capability check (executor.zig ExecutionContext.service_catalog, host_api/call_service.zig lookup + real HTTP + table return); (3) LUA-16 captureStackTrace via lua_getstack/lua_getinfo walk + conditional ScriptErrorPayload construction, skip when LUA-08 instruction-count source not installed (luajit_bindings.zig new externs, events.zig constructors, executor.zig ScriptResult.script_error). Add zig build test step (test-lua-12-15-16) and a regression test file under src/lua/ that follows the project's per-test UUID isolation, defer cleanup, and integration-test conventions. LUA-12 HTTP client must be a function pointer in ExecutionContext (test stub for now; OPEN-LUA-12-HTTP-CLIENT-PROD followup). LUA-15 registry-based anti-forgery must follow host_context.zig's exact pattern. Run zig build, zig build test, tools/lint_handoffs.py, tools/lint_test_isolation.py. All must exit 0. Use real UTC timestamps from tools/utcnow.py, BOM-tolerant JSON, UTF-8 writes, append-only orchestrator log. Commit and push to feature/WF03-GH592-20260808. Update step-03 handoff + registry/log. Return PASS routing to TEST-DESIGNER (Step 4).
acceptance_criteria: LUA-12: ExecutionContext.service_catalog field is added with default null
LUA-12: non-simulation branch calls lookup() first; missing service raises 'service <id> not registered'
LUA-12: simulation branch also calls lookup() first (defense-in-depth)
LUA-12: real path (simulation context null) calls HTTP client function pointer, returns single table
LUA-12: return shape is return 1 (single table), not return 2
LUA-15: __failure_reason__ / __failure_details__ / __explicit_failure__ are removed from host_api/fail.zig
LUA-15: host_context.setExplicitFailure writes to bpm.failure_reason / bpm.failure_details / bpm.explicit_failure in LUA_REGISTRYINDEX
LUA-15: host_context.readExplicitFailure returns .Explicit / .None
LUA-15: executeSource calls readExplicitFailure in failed-pcall branch; sets ScriptResult.error_kind
LUA-15: ScriptResult.error_kind is ExplicitFailure for platform.fail, RuntimeError otherwise
LUA-16: lua_getstack / lua_getinfo are declared in luajit_bindings.zig
LUA-16: captureStackTrace(L, allocator) returns a single string with one line per frame
LUA-16: ScriptResult.script_error is null when error_kind != .RuntimeError
LUA-16: when LUA-08 is installed, script_error.instruction_count is the limiter's count
LUA-16: when LUA-08 is NOT installed, script_error.capabilities_at_failure is the skip reason string
All three commits on feature/WF03-GH592-20260808 pass zig build and zig build test
CHANGELOG.md has the LUA-12 breaking-change note
No MSW / HTTP mocking library introduced (T-1)
No mocks/stubs in test source files (T-1) - the LUA-12 stub HTTP client is a function pointer, not a mock
tools/lint_handoffs.py exits 0
tools/lint_test_isolation.py exits 0 for new tests
Per-test UUID isolation in all new test files
zig build test-lua-12-15-16 step added in build.zig and passes
